data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Please confirm that the secret token used on your receiving end is an exact match for the 'Webhook Secret' currently configured in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, ensure that your verification algorithm is set to HMAC-SHA256 to align with our security standards. Verifying these matches should resolve the signature rejection. [T-1347] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
